name: answer_question
title: Answer a Question
description: Point the three agents at a question instead of an app. They reason from different angles, debate to the strongest answer, then write it up. No build phase.

phases.title: Deliberation
phases.purpose: Reason through the question from genuinely different angles, surface the strongest candidate answers, and pressure-test them against each other.

phases.title: Answer
phases.purpose: Commit to the single best-supported answer and write it clearly, noting the key reasoning and any honest uncertainty.
